listed_sector_signals.signal: Literature reference to applying ISO 50001 at a cement plant to reduce electricity consumption
listed_sector_signals.quote:
Pelser et al. have found 
that it is possible to reduce electricity consumption at a cement plant by 25 % using the ISO 
50001 approach and without additional investments in equipment [10].

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Mention of biomass combined heat and power plants (cogeneration) in Latvia
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
in Latvia there is great potential for developing other renewable technologies, instead of biomass 
combined heat and power plants (CHP) [31]

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Centralised heat energy production (district heating) as a SECAP focus area
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The main focus areas of SECAP are centralised heat energy production, energy savings in buildings, energy savings of 
street lighting and public transport.

one_line: Case study of implementing a certified ISO 50001 energy management system in the municipality of Daugavpils, Latvia, covering public buildings, street lighting and public transport; continuous-process contexts (cement plant, biomass CHP, district heating) appear only as literature citations or peripheral mentions.
